jobs.title: Summer Student Intern - CRU Project Support
PhD Research Intern, AI Accelerator Design and VLSI - 2027
jobs.descriptionText: NVIDIA Research is seeking PhD-level students to work as research interns at the intersection of AI HW/SW Co-Design, Hardware Accelerator Architecture, IC Design Methodology, and VLSI Design. Ideal candidates will have a broad perspective across areas including machine learning fundamentals, quantization and numerical methods for machine learning model optimization, digital VLSI circuits for computer arithmetic, high-productivity VLSI design and verification methodologies including applications of agentic AI to hardware design, AI hardware micro-architecture, and VLSI methodology and implementation. What You’ll Be Doing: Accelerator Design: Contribute to novel research advancing the state-of-the-art in the design of accelerators for AI and other high-impact workloads. VLSI: Research creative and innovative ASIC and VLSI design techniques and/or novel digital VLSI circuits. Apply machine learning, agentic AI, and state-of-the-art tools and methodologies to automated ASIC and VLSI design tool flows. AI HW/SW Co-Design: Research and develop creative and innovative numerical methods for quantization, sparsity, or tensor decomposition grounded in computer arithmetic fundamentals and digital VLSI circuits. Collaborate on the development of research prototype testchips. Collaborate with AI researchers and hardware team members in research and product teams. Plan to publish and present your original research. What We Need To See: Pursuing a PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. Publication records in leading ML, architecture, VLSI, or circuits conferences. Excellent programming skills in Python/PyTorch and hardware design languages such as SystemVerilog/C++; Experience with High-Level Synthesis (HLS) tools is a plus. VLSI Implementation Skills: Experience in hardware design with proficiency with modern EDA tool flows; Tapeout experience is a plus. Excellent self-motivation, a high degree of creativity, and a passion for research, collaboration skills, and the ability to work effectively within a research team. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proven experience communicating technical work (e.g., academic presentations, poster sessions); ability to synthesize and explain complex technical concepts. Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA has some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world inventing the future for us. Are you a creative and collaborative researcher interested in seeking new challenges? If so, we want to hear from you! Our internship hourly rates are a standard pay based on the position, your location, year in school, degree, and experience. The hourly rate for our interns is 38 USD - 94 USD. You will also be eligible for Intern benefits. Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 31, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy. You will gain hands-on experience by sustaining and improving manufacturing equipment, troubleshooting issues, and supporting qualification activities. This internship offers a unique opportunity to apply your academic knowledge, build practical skills, and contribute to real-world projects in a dynamic environment that fosters growth and innovation. Business Group Intel Foundry is focused on advancing semiconductor manufacturing technologies and delivering innovative solutions to meet customer needs worldwide. As part of this organization, you will join a group dedicated to sustaining high-performance manufacturing processes and driving process optimization to support Intel's broader mission of technological excellence. Key Responsibilities Support the development and implementation of manufacturing processes for a specific module in semiconductor production. Sustain and enhance manufacturing equipment performance to ensure operational reliability and efficiency. Assist in troubleshooting equipment issues and performing qualification activities to achieve production standards. Collaborate with engineering teams to optimize process control methodologies and enhance process efficiency. Apply statistical analysis and experimental design to improve process reliability and throughput. Gain hands-on experience with materials and device characterization techniques, such as SEM and TEM. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives for process control systems and methodologies. Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications Currently pursuing a Ph.D. degree in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or another STEM-related field. Familiarity with statistical data analysis and experimental design methodologies. Experience in materials and physical device characterization techniques like SEM or TEM, gained through coursework, academic research, or hands-on training. Preferred Qualifications Expertise in advanced semiconductor device structures, fabrication techniques, and process integration. Proficiency in statistical analysis tools and programming languages such as JMP, Python, MATLAB, or C++. Hands-on research experience in device fabrication, physical characterization, or materials testing. Strong foundational knowledge in process control systems and semiconductor device physics. Explore the opportunity to grow your expertise in cutting-edge semiconductor manufacturing while contributing to innovative solutions in a collaborative environment. jobs.descriptionText: Overview Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) organization powers one of the largest and most advanced global datacenter infrastructures in the world - delivering secure, compliant, cost-effective, and highly available cloud services that customers depend on. As a Business Program Manager Intern in the Executive Office supporting the President , you will play a critical role in serves as an operational integrator across CO+I, connecting leaders, teams, priorities, and operating mechanisms so the organization functions as one system. This role provides horizontal support across Strategy & Planning, Delivery & Execution, and DC Operations teams, closes functional gaps, improves handoffs, and keeps decisions connected to execution. This role builds and sustains the organization’s operating model through Rhythm of Business (ROB), governance, performance reporting, budgeting, workforce planning, executive communications, and business data management. The Business Program Manager Intern applies systems thinking to anticipate downstream impacts, resolve friction across organizational boundaries, and design scalable mechanisms that improve end-to-end performance. A successful candidate in this role sets a high bar for first-pass quality and ensures analyses, reports, communications, and decision materials are accurate, complete, and leadership-ready before review. At Microsoft, Interns work on real-world projects in collaboration with teams across the world, while having fun along the way. You’ll be empowered to build community, explore your passions and achieve your goals. This is your chance to bring your solutions and ideas to life while working on cutting-edge technology. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. #EiP Responsibilities Ensures the effectiveness and continuity of organization-wide operating rhythms, governance, and cross-functional execution. Ensures quality, accuracy, timeliness, and decision usefulness of executive reporting and communications. Drives closure of organizational gaps, dependencies, actions, escalations, and risks. Supports alignment of budgets, workforce plans, and resources to strategic priorities. Helps maintain reliable business and workforce data, standardized processes, and scalable operating mechanisms. Qualifications Required/Minimum Qualifications: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field. Must have at least one semester/term of school remaining following the completion of the internship. Preferred Qualifications Studying business operations, program management, strategy, business finance and workforce planning. Supporting executive leadership teams and leading complex cross-functional initiatives. Strong financial acumen, business planning, workforce planning, and operational management capabilities. Experience building governance frameworks, operating models, reporting systems, and scalable business processes. Strong systems thinking, with the ability to anticipate downstream impacts and translate ambiguity into structure, decisions, and measurable outcomes. Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with a demonstrated commitment to accuracy, completeness, and leadership-ready work. This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Research Intern, Robotics - 2027
tags: SG02 NVIDIA SG Dev Pte. Ltd.
jobs.descriptionText: NVIDIA Research is seeking research interns in Singapore to advance fundamental and applied robotics research, with a particular focus on agentic robotics. We are interested in exploring how AI agents can autonomously develop, refine, and generalize robotic capabilities by integrating reasoning, programming, experimentation, and feedback within the full robot systems stack. Our research spans robot learning, planning, simulation, perception, and control, with an emphasis on building intelligent systems that can generalize over tasks, environments, and embodiments. We are looking for interns with strong research and engineering skills, intellectual curiosity, and a collaborative mindset. You will have the opportunity to formulate and pursue ambitious research questions, develop novel algorithms and systems, and validate your ideas through rigorous experimentation. Research projects will be aligned with your expertise and the team's priorities, with opportunities to contribute to scientific publications and practical robotic systems. What you will be doing * Conduct research on novel models, algorithms, and systems for agentic robotics. * Investigate how AI agents can autonomously develop, evaluate, and improve robotic programs and capabilities. * Explore research directions at the intersection of foundation models, robot learning, planning, and programming. * Develop and evaluate methods for robotic skill acquisition, adaptation, and generalization. * Design and conduct experiments in simulation and, where appropriate, on physical robots. * Collaborate with researchers and engineers across robotics and AI, and communicate research outcomes through publications, demonstrations, open-source contributions, and presentation. What we need to see * Currently pursuing a PhD in robotics, artificial intelligence, computer science, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field. * Strong technical foundation in robotics, AI, or related areas, with an interest in real-world robotic systems. * Demonstrated ability to conduct independent research, evidenced by publications, impactful projects, or substantial research contributions. * Strong programming skills and experience in developing research software. * Ability to formulate research questions, implement novel methods, and rigorously evaluate experimental results. * Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. Ways to stand out from the crowd * Research experience in AI coding agents, robotics, foundation models, or program synthesis. * Expertise in one or more areas such as robot learning, planning, simulation, perception, control, ... * Familiarity with robotics and simulation platforms such as ROS 2, Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, or MuJoCo. * Experience implementing and validating methods on real robotic systems. * Publications at leading robotics conferences and journals, such as RSS, CoRL, ICRA, IROS, T-RO, IJRR, or RA-L. Join NVIDIA Research to explore how AI agents can transform robotics research and industry. NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing. Today, our AI infrastructure powers global intelligence, transforming every industry. Learn more about NVIDIA.

jobs.title: AI Hardware Engineering Intern
jobs.descriptionText: Job Details: Job Description: About the Job Intel is seeking exceptional Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, and AI/ML students to join an AI Hardware Engineering internship focused on the future of AI inference and AI infrastructure with hardware/software co-design expertise. This internship approaches AI infrastructure as a hardware/software co-design challenge. The intern will analyze how model architecture, inference behavior, memory movement, data-center constraints, and software stacks influence end-to-end customer outcomes, including throughput, latency, time-to-first-token, tokens per second, power consumption, utilization, total cost of ownership, and deployability. The successful candidate will be technically hands-on, capable of independent research and analysis, and comfortable working within a highly technical team of researchers and engineers addressing complex AI hardware and infrastructure challenges. What You Will Do Conduct technical research on the next generation of AI infrastructure, including CPUs, GPUs, AI accelerators, ASICs, memory systems, networking, storage, rack-scale architecture, power delivery, cooling, and cluster management. Analyze GenAI and agentic AI workloads to understand their hardware implications, including transformer architecture based inference, mixture-of-experts architectures, multimodal models, real-time interactive inference, and distributed serving. Evaluate the hardware behavior of AI inference pipelines, including the distinct demands of prompt processing/prefill and token generation/decode, memory capacity, memory bandwidth, KV-cache management, compute utilization, interconnect bandwidth, and latency. For example, cluster architecture around optimizing both prefill and decode through hardware, memory, and system co-design. Identify product and system gaps that may limit Intel's ability to serve AI customers effectively, including hardware capabilities, developer tooling, performance libraries, reference architectures, deployment models, observability, and ecosystem enablement. - Expertise in modern high-performance CPU, GPU, or AI accelerator architecture and hardware/software interactions. - Support Silicon HW programs through multiple phases of the silicon lifecycle, with end-to-end chip execution from concept to silicon. - Good understanding with firmware codebases, compilers, kernels, serving stacks and model architectures. - Familiar with driving silicon design for subsystems and/or top-level functions with ASICs and SOCs from an architecture specification to production silicon including memory subsystems and interconnects: scale up, scale out, scale across, power management , liquid cooling at rack scale level, deep system level observability & telemetry and dependent impact into Gen AI and LLM level performance/tco/execution KPIs Develop technical recommendations for what Intel should build, optimize, enable, partner on to meet AI customer requirements based on deep understanding of customer use cases, workload performance, and ML systems research. Benchmark and compare relevant AI hardware and infrastructure approaches across performance, power efficiency, cost, programmability, memory hierarchy, scalability, ecosystem maturity, and workload fit. Develop technical models, simulations, prototypes, or analysis tools to evaluate hardware/software trade offs for AI workloads. Investigate system bottlenecks across compute, memory, networking, storage, and software orchestration, and propose methods to improve end-to-end AI workload performance. Work with Intel technical teams and external ISVs to collect data on model requirements, inference bottlenecks, deployment challenges, hardware optimization opportunities, and customer priorities. Engage with AI software ecosystem partners, including model providers, inference-engine developers, cloud providers, framework teams, and ISVs, to understand how their stacks interact with underlying hardware. Good understanding of modern AI software layers, including PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, model serving, TensorRT-LLM, Triton, Kubernetes, and Neocloud design efficiencies. Present findings through architecture diagrams, benchmark analyses, technical reports, design recommendations, and executive-ready presentations. Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, AI/ML, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Strong foundation in computer architecture, operating systems, distributed systems, parallel computing, AI/ML systems, high-performance computing, or systems software. Familiarity with generative AI models and inference concepts, including transformers, attention, token generation, model serving, quantization, batching, KV cache, long-context workloads, and latency-throughput trade-offs. Experience programming in one or more of the languages - C, C++, Rust, CUDA, SYCL, OpenCL, or a comparable low-level or performance-oriented language. Strong academic performance with a cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher required. Preferred Qualifications Coursework, research, or project experience in computer architecture, VLSI, digital design, ASIC/FPGA systems, compilers, kernel development, GPU programming, distributed systems, high-performance computing, or AI systems. Experience using profiling, tracing, or benchmarking tools to evaluate CPU, GPU, accelerator, network, memory, storage, or software performance. Familiarity with AI hardware platforms such as Intel Xeon processors, Intel GPUs, NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, TPUs, custom AI accelerators, FPGAs, or domain-specific inference ASICs. Understanding of memory hierarchies and performance concepts, including cache behavior, DRAM, HBM, memory bandwidth, memory capacity, latency, data locality, DMA, and data movement. Experience with inference frameworks or runtimes such as vLLM, SGLang, Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch, Triton, or Ray. Familiarity with AI systems infrastructure such as Linux, containers, Kubernetes, distributed storage, RDMA over Ethernet, InfiniBand, CXL, PCIe, NVMe, UALink/eSUN based interconnects, silicon photonics and cluster-management software. Some experience with simulation, modeling, emulation, RTL, FPGA prototyping, firmware, driver development, or low-level debugging. Some experience contributing to open-source systems, ML infrastructure, compiler, kernel, framework, or performance-engineering projects. jobs.title: Applied Research Intern, Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC)-NVIDIA Aerial - Summer 2027
jobs.descriptionText: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. NVIDIA is looking for a graduate research intern to help advance integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) on NVIDIA GPU-accelerated platforms! The right person will join a team building AI-native wireless systems, as well as develop, train, and test ISAC algorithms end-to-end on the NVIDIA Aerial Testbed, which combines our GPU-accelerated 5G/6G software stack with real over-the-air radios. This role suits a student who enjoys both deep algorithm work and turning ideas into working systems. What you’ll be doing: Develop, implement, and benchmark ISAC algorithms in Python on NVIDIA GPU platforms. Build radar signal processing pipelines, including radar cube formation, range and Doppler processing, angle estimation, CFAR detection, and clutter suppression (for example MTI, static clutter removal, and adaptive filtering). Compose new ML model architectures for sensing and joint sensing-communications tasks, and formulate the corresponding loss functions and optimization objectives. Train and evaluate models in PyTorch using both simulated data and data captured over the air. Integrate your algorithms with the NVIDIA Aerial Testbed and run real-time, over-the-air experiments. Detail your results and contribute to publications, patents, and internal technical reports. What we need to see: Currently enrolled in an MS or PhD program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. Strong background in AI/ML for wireless communications. Solid understanding of ISAC concepts and waveforms, such as OFDM-based sensing. Hands-on experience implementing ISAC or radar algorithms in Python. Hands-on experience with PyTorch or another machine learning framework (for example TensorFlow or JAX). Confirmed ability to build new ML model architectures and formulate optimization and loss functions. Knowledge of the signal processing aspects of ISAC, including radar cube algorithms and clutter reduction techniques. Strong communication skills and the ability to work well in a collaborative research team. Ways to stand out from the crowd: PhD candidate with publications in ISAC, radar, or ML for wireless. Hands-on experience with real-time over-the-air wireless testbeds, such as software-defined radios (for example USRP) or 5G testbeds. Experience with GPU programming or acceleration (CUDA, CuPy, or similar). Familiarity with NVIDIA Aerial (CUDA-Accelerated RAN, Aerial Omniverse Digital Twin) or NVIDIA Sionna. Knowledge of the 3GPP 5G NR physical layer and 6G ISAC study items. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you! Our internship hourly rates are a standard pay based on the position, your location, year in school, degree, and experience. The hourly rate for our interns is 20 USD - 71 USD. jobs.descriptionText: Job Details: Job Description: The Role and Impact As a Module Engineering PhD Intern, you will play a key role in developing and sustaining semiconductor manufacturing processes for a specific module. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include supporting equipment troubleshooting, performing maintenance and qualification activities, and collaborating with engineering teams to optimize process control methodologies. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in semiconductor manufacturing while building essential skills for a future career in engineering. Business group You will join the Intel Foundry team, a dynamic and innovative group dedicated to delivering cutting-edge manufacturing solutions that drive Intel's technology forward. The team focuses on advancing semiconductor fabrication processes in areas such as Diffusion, Dielectrics, Implant, EPI, and FE Metals. As part of this group, you will contribute to Intel's mission of creating world-changing technology that enables global progress and enriches lives. What We Do As members of the Manufacturing Development and Customer Engineering (MDCE) team, we are responsible for improving process capability for multiple technology nodes (Intel 18A, Intel 3, Intel 12nm and upcoming technologies) from initial product qualification through high volume manufacturing. The focus will be on delivering yield improvement, performance enhancement, variation and cost reduction. Key Responsibilities Assist with the development and implementation of thin film manufacturing processes for a specific module within Intel's semiconductor production. Support troubleshooting and maintenance activities for manufacturing equipment to ensure optimal performance. Participate in equipment qualification processes, ensuring compliance with quality and functional standards. Collaborate with engineering teams to optimize process control methodologies and achieve production targets. Establish strong working relationships and partner closely with technology development, high volume manufacturing and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve common goals. Analyze data trends, identify solutions for process improvement and drive automation improvements (using AI where applicable) Contribute to sustaining and improving manufacturing tools and processes while gaining hands-on experience in semiconductor engineering. Ability to work independently and as part of a diverse, high-performing team. Willingness to work in a cleanroom environment. Strong attention to detail and disciplined approach to procedures. Data analysis skills with demonstrated ability to construct clear data-based problem statements, design of experiment. Preferred Qualifications Experience with data analysis tools and software (e.g. JMP, Python, Excel, and AI tools). Ability to summarize data for technical and non-technical audiences. jobs.title: Research Intern - Algorithms Group: Generative Modeling
jobs.descriptionText: Overview Research Internships at Microsoft provide a dynamic environment for research careers with a network of world-class research labs led by globally-recognized scientists and engineers, who pursue innovation in a range of scientific and technical disciplines to help solve complex challenges in diverse fields, including computing, healthcare, economics, and the environment. The Algorithms group at MSR Redmond is looking for Research Interns to advance research in generative modeling. Opportunities include fundamental algorithmic innovation to enhance the efficiency and generation quality of existing models (e.g., diffusion models, image auto-regressive models, language models) and the design of next-generation generative modeling techniques (see examples below). Latent Zoning Network: A Unified Principle for Generative Modeling, Representation Learning, and Classification (NeurIPS 2025) Distilled Decoding 1: One-step Sampling of Image Auto-regressive Models with Flow Matching (ICLR 2025) Distilled Decoding 2: One-step Sampling of Image Auto-regressive Models with Conditional Score Distillation (NeurIPS 2025) Weak-to-Strong On-Policy Distillation Can LLMs Learn by Teaching for Better Reasoning? A Preliminary Study (NeurIPS 2024) Our researchers and Research Interns have been conducting influential research published in top-tier venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR. For more details on our research group and projects, please see: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/group/algorithms-redmond/ For the fullest consideration, please apply by January 1, 2027. Responsibilities Research Interns put inquiry and theory into practice. Alongside fellow doctoral candidates and some of the world’s best researchers, Research Interns learn, collaborate, and network for life. Research Interns not only advance their own careers, but they also contribute to exciting research and development strides. During the 12-week internship, Research Interns are paired with mentors and expected to collaborate with other Research Interns and researchers, present findings, and contribute to the vibrant life of the community. Research internships are available in all areas of research, and are offered year-round, though they typically begin in the summer. Qualifications Required Qualifications Currently enrolled in a master's degree program in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or a related STEM field. Other Requirements Research Interns are expected to be physically located in their manager’s Microsoft worksite location for the duration of their internship. In addition to the qualifications below, you’ll need to submit a minimum of two reference letters for this position as well as a cover letter and any relevant work or research samples. After you submit your application, a request for letters may be sent to your list of references on your behalf. Note that reference letters cannot be requested until after you have submitted your application, and furthermore, that they might not be automatically requested for all candidates. You may wish to alert your letter writers in advance, so they will be ready to submit your letter. Preferred Qualifications Currently enrolled in a Doctorate Degree program in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or a related STEM field. Publications at top theoretical CS or ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.) or top journals. Familiarity with frameworks such as PyTorch. Experience with training large foundation models such as diffusion models, image auto-regressive models, and large language models. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $7,410 - $12,250 per month. jobs.descriptionText: Overview Research Internships at Microsoft provide a dynamic environment for research careers with a network of world-class research labs led by globally-recognized scientists and engineers, who pursue innovation in a range of scientific and technical disciplines to help solve complex challenges in diverse fields, including computing, healthcare, economics, and the environment. This position is for a research internship with the EPIC (Extended Perception, Interaction & Cognition) research group in Microsoft Research’s Redmond Lab. We have multiple positions available. Research Internships will be focused on creating new interactive experiences that “blend artificial and human intelligence”. Topics range from coupling the power of generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques with interaction design to reinvent how we work with content, to building the next generation of multi-modal interfaces adapting in real time to user tasks and contexts. Key skills sought for this internship include: Generative AI: Large Language Models (LLMs), Vision Language Models (VLMs), Stable Diffusion, video/world/action models, real-time models, multi-agent development, and related technologies Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) system building and agentic development: Experience building interactive prototypes with TypeScript, Node.js, and React, using coding agents and agentic workflows to accelerate development. Demonstrated programming and software architecture fundamentals are essential to guide agents, review generated code, and validate system behavior. Additional relevant skills (depending on projects): Interaction design: experience with devising multimodal interactions (touch, pen, speech), context sensing, responsive & adaptive User Interfaces (UIs) Experience design: storyboarding, envisioning video techniques User Experience (UX) research: conducting qualitative and quantitative user studies We value your ideas and unique viewpoints on these topics, as well, and hope that our partnership and collaboration will shape initial directions into exciting, ambitious, and impactful research contributions that only you could have crafted. The EPIC group conducts fundamental research that innovates at the nexus of hardware, software, and human potential. We are an interdisciplinary group of researchers, engineers, scientists, and designers at Microsoft Research who study Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) through prototyping, system-building, design sketching, and observational study of human behavior. jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern - Summer 2027
jobs.descriptionText: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. ## Who are we? Netflix is the world's leading streaming entertainment service with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, documentaries, feature films, and mobile games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can watch as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, on any internet-connected screen. It’s no secret that we want to entertain the world. To do that, we build teams with a mix of experience and fresh perspective. Emerging talent plays a big part in that, bringing new ideas that push us to keep growing. If you have a passion for solving challenging problems, we want to hear from you. Maybe you love learning how to build scalable, robust systems. Maybe you thrive working with the latest technologies in a dynamic environment where priorities evolve and ideas move quickly. And maybe the idea of making a global impact on software that over 300 million people use and love gets you fired up. If that sounds like you, we want to see your application! Who are you? \- You’re a current, enrolled student pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field such as Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or Statistics, with an expected graduation date between December 2027 and Spring/Summer 2028. Minored in a technical field, or majoring in something non-technical while teaching yourself to code? We still want you to apply! \- You’ve studied coursework or have relevant experience with data structures, algorithms, and debugging. Bonus points if you’ve completed at least one of these courses: Distributed Systems, Web Development, Mobile Development, Network or Application Security, Machine Learning, or AI. \- You’re eager to leverage AI to amplify your work. You use it to explore ideas, move faster, and sharpen your thinking, and you validate outputs before you trust them. \- You love exploring new solutions, and you’re willing to break things along the way to learn. \- You make confident decisions that are well thought out, and you’re willing to share your ideas and perspectives. \- You can work independently, and you know that asking a teammate for a fresh perspective is a strength, not a weakness. \- You do your best work alongside others and enjoy building as a team. You’re curious about how different people see a problem, and you let those ideas shape what you create. \- You’re a clear, concise communicator who tells a good story and tailors it to your audience. \- You’re passionate about Netflix’s mission to Entertain the World, and you believe you can thrive in our culture. What could you learn to do? \- Build applications that solve complex business problems elegantly \- Create tools that are intuitive, engaging, and surface business insights for our partners \- Write high-quality, performant, industry-standard code \- Integrate scalable system design and architectural best practices into the development lifecycle \- Use AI tools to move faster on scoped engineering work, like understanding unfamiliar code, brainstorming approaches, drafting tests, and improving documentation \- Build good judgment about AI: validating its output, spotting when it’s wrong or overconfident, and handling privacy and security responsibly \- Work closely with business stakeholders in a dynamic, fast-moving environment Don’t meet every single requirement? You may be the right candidate for this or other roles. Candidates with significant relevant work experience may not be considered. While prior internships are okay, we may not consider candidates with multiple years of relevant work experience. We match qualified interns with projects and groups based on interests and skill sets, and fully embed interns within those groups for the summer. Netflix is a unique place to work and we live by our values, so it's worth learning more about our culture. Internships are paid and are a minimum of 12 weeks, with a choice of a few fixed start dates in May or June 2027 to accommodate varying school calendars. Our summer internships will be located in our Los Gatos, CA office, or in our Los Angeles, CA office, depending on the team. jobs.descriptionText: Overview Research Internships at Microsoft provide a dynamic environment for research careers with a network of world-class research labs led by globally-recognized scientists and engineers, who pursue innovation in a range of scientific and technical disciplines to help solve complex challenges in diverse fields, including computing, healthcare, economics, and the environment. The Interactive Multimodal Futures (IMF) group at Microsoft Research seeks a PhD-level Research Intern to work on a project at the intersection of situated interaction , social computing , ubiquitous computing, and human-centered Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems . The project will include elements of multimodal sensing (physiology, speech, gaze, gestures, olfaction/gas, etc.), signal processing, and real-time interaction. Our group’s research spans several sub-areas: Human-centered AI for affective and social computing, and adaptive experiences. Situated interaction between humans and AI systems such as robots deployed in the physical world. Conversational AI Agents that are socially and context aware. Ubiquitous sensing and ambient intelligence with unobtrusive sensing in the real world. You will collaborate with IMF researchers to prototype systems, run user studies, develop machine learning models, and explore technical capabilities of generative AI for human-AI interaction. Responsibilities Research Interns put inquiry and theory into practice. Alongside fellow doctoral candidates and some of the world’s best researchers, Research Interns learn, collaborate, and network for life. Proficient collaboration and communication skills. Conducting human-subjects research. Experience implementing research prototypes (frontend, backend, or both). We see strong interest in optimization of such key functionalities from various industrial and research organizations - from gaming and machine learning to autonomous driving and chip modeling. Projects will involve implementing new numerical algorithms, defining APIs, analyzing performance, finding appropriate solutions for difficult numerical corner cases, and other general software engineering work. jobs.title: PhD Research Intern, Autonomous Systems and Physical AI Research - 2027
jobs.descriptionText: We are recruiting outstanding Research Interns to work on autonomous vehicles, robotics, and physical AI! Intelligent machines that can perceive, reason, and safely interact with people and the physical world are rapidly becoming a reality. Self-driving cars, autonomous delivery and construction vehicles, mobile manipulators, and other robotic systems are moving closer to widespread deployment. However, fundamental research challenges remain before these systems can operate safely, reliably, and autonomously in complex, unfamiliar environments. For example, how can we: Develop new training paradigms that use perception and interaction to train autonomous vehicle and robot policies in closed loop? Equip autonomous systems with online and offline assurances that meet the requirements of safety-critical applications? Enable vehicles and robots to navigate across new environments, tasks, and embodiments? Build systems that reason under uncertainty and interact safely and naturally with people and other agents? These are some of the exciting questions being explored by NVIDIA’s Autonomous Systems and Physical AI Research (ASPIRE) group. Our diverse, interdisciplinary team conducts foundational research spanning foundation model design, embodied reasoning, safety, closed-loop training and evaluation, and agentic workflows for Physical AI development. We also investigate related areas including decision-making under uncertainty, deep learning, reinforcement learning, simulation, and the verification and validation of safety-critical AI systems. Our focus is on fundamental research, and lab members are encouraged to publish their work and open-source their code. NVIDIA is known for its collaborative culture, and our researchers work closely with experts across the company in autonomous vehicles, robotics, perception, simulation, and machine learning. This creates opportunities to influence real-world products while retaining the freedom and bandwidth to conduct groundbreaking, publishable research. What you’ll be doing: Designing and implementing cutting-edge techniques for autonomous vehicles, robotics, and physical AI. Conducting original research and publishing your results. Collaborating with research colleagues, internal product teams, and external researchers. Transferring technology you’ve developed to relevant product groups. Strong knowledge of the theory and practice of vehicle or robot autonomy—or expertise in a related area, with a strong interest in applying your work to autonomous systems. A track record of research excellence, demonstrated through publications at leading conferences and journals—such as RSS, ICRA, CoRL, IJRR, NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, TAC, etc.—and through other research artifacts such as open-source software. jobs.descriptionText: Job Details: Job Description: Intel is seeking an AI Infrastructure Solution Architect Intern to join our AI Platforms team. As an intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers to support AI accelerator platforms, cluster deployments, system validation, and AI workload benchmarking. This role provides hands-on experience across AI infrastructure, system software, cluster operations, firmware debugging, and end-to-end AI solution development. The ideal candidate is passionate about AI systems, computer architecture, Linux, and large-scale computing environments, and enjoys solving complex technical problems. Responsibilities AI Infrastructure and Cluster Operations: Assist in deploying and validating AI accelerator systems and multi-node AI clusters. Support cluster bring-up activities, including system provisioning, software installation, and health verification. Execute performance benchmarks and collect system telemetry. Help troubleshoot system, networking, and software issues in AI environments. System Debugging and Validation: Analyze hardware, firmware, driver, and software logs to identify failures. Assist with validation of BIOS, firmware, and system software configurations. Support development of test plans and automated validation workflows. Participate in root-cause investigations of system performance and stability issues. AI/ML Workloads Deploy and evaluate AI models using frameworks such as PyTorch and vLLM. Benchmark AI workloads and identify performance bottlenecks. Assist in reproducing customer-reported issues in lab environments. Contribute to optimization studies for AI inference and training workloads. Automation and Tool Development: Develop Python-based tools to automate testing, monitoring, and data collection. Create dashboards, scripts, and utilities for cluster management and diagnostics. Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and technical knowledge bases. End-to-End AI Solutions Participate in building end-to-end AI solutions, such as generative AI, agentic AI, computer vision, robotics, or intelligent automation projects. Work with cross-functional teams to integrate hardware, software, AI models, and applications into complete solutions. Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications Currently pursuing Master's in: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or AI/ML or related fields Experience with Python programming. Familiarity with Linux command line and system administration concepts. Understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, networking, or distributed systems. Demonstrated ability to solve complex engineering or technical problems through coursework, research, personal projects, robotics competitions, hackathons, open-source contributions, or previous internships. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and collaborate in a team environment. Preferred Qualifications Technical Skills - Experience with: Python, C/C++, or Bash scripting Linux/Unix environments Git and software development workflows Docker or containerized applications Familiarity with: PyTorch, TensorFlow, or other AI frameworks LLMs, RAG, agentic AI, or generative AI applications Cloud or cluster computing environments GPU or AI accelerator technologies Project Experience - Coursework, research, personal projects, or internships involving: AI/ML applications Robotics systems Autonomous systems Computer vision Distributed computing High-performance computing (HPC) End-to-end AI solution development Soft Skills: Strong communication and presentation skills. Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies. Ability to diagnose problems systematically and communicate findings clearly. jobs.title: Full Stack Developer Intern, Training Center Operations Experience
Stagiaire en opérations critiques Centre de données / Critical Environment Ops INTERN Data Center
jobs.descriptionText: Overview English follows French Nous recrutons pour plusieurs stages de 6 mois qui débuteront en janvier 2027 . Aperçu du poste: Conformément aux valeurs de Microsoft, nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail inclusif pour tous les employés, afin d’avoir un impact positif sur notre culture au quotidien. Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons des stagiaires technicien(ne)s en environnement critique de centre de données (CET). L’équipe Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) de Microsoft est au cœur de nos services infonuagiques. À titre de stagiaire CET, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la prestation de l’infrastructure de base et des technologies fondamentales qui soutiennent les services en ligne de Microsoft, notamment Bing, Microsoft 365, Xbox, OneDrive et la plateforme Microsoft Azure. CO+I met fortement l’accent sur le développement personnel et professionnel de ses employés et offre diverses formations et occasions de croissance, notamment des programmes de rotation de carrière, des formations et événements en diversité et inclusion, ainsi que des certifications professionnelles. Notre infrastructure comprend un vaste portefeuille mondial de plus de 100 centres de données et plus d’un million de serveurs. Elle repose sur une équipe d’experts travaillant à soutenir des services destinés à plus d’un milliard de clients et 20 millions d’entreprises dans plus de 90 pays. En plaçant la durabilité environnementale et l’optimisation au cœur de la conception et des opérations de nos centres de données, nous continuons d’évoluer pour répondre aux besoins d’affaires en constante évolution, tout en maintenant la position de Microsoft comme fournisseur de services infonuagiques de classe mondiale. Souhaitez-vous contribuer à donner les moyens d’agir à des milliards de personnes à travers le monde? Joignez-vous à CO+I et participez activement à cette mission! La mission de Microsoft est de permettre à chaque personne et à chaque organisation sur la planète d’accomplir davantage. En tant qu’employés, nous nous réunissons avec un état d’esprit de croissance, innovons pour autonomiser les autres et collaborons pour réaliser nos objectifs communs. Chaque jour, nous nous appuyons sur nos valeurs de respect, d’intégrité et de responsabilité pour créer une culture d’inclusion où chacun peut s’épanouir au travail et au-delà. Responsabilités : Apprendre à utiliser tous les systèmes et équipements de manière sécuritaire et professionnelle, ainsi qu’à comprendre les risques associés, avec la possibilité d’obtenir la certification Microsoft CET niveau 1. Effectuer la surveillance et l’inspection de base des équipements des environnements critiques, des installations et des terrains afin de détecter toute condition anormale ou non sécuritaire, ainsi que le suivi de base du rendement des opérations et de la maintenance des équipements (p. ex., électriques, mécaniques, systèmes de protection incendie et de sécurité des personnes) au sein du centre de données. Utiliser le système informatisé de gestion de la maintenance (GMAO/CMMS) pour assurer le suivi des actifs et créer des demandes d’intervention pour les travaux de maintenance. Soutenir de façon sécuritaire la surveillance et les interventions d’urgence en réponse à diverses conditions anormales, sous supervision et conformément aux procédures d’exploitation d’urgence (EOP). Recueillir les informations nécessaires et participer à la documentation des incidents (chronologies, analyses des causes fondamentales et mesures correctives) à la suite de conditions anormales, au besoin. Effectuer différents types de maintenance (p. ex., préventive, prédictive, corrective) selon les tâches assignées, en respectant les méthodes d’exécution (MOP) et les procédures d’exploitation normalisées (SOP); fournir du soutien en préparant le matériel et en réalisant des tâches administratives selon les directives. Documenter les tâches et les problèmes identifiés lors des activités de maintenance et de dépannage afin d’assurer le suivi requis et effectuer les escalades appropriées. Incarner notre culture et nos valeurs . Qualifications requises : Diplôme d’études secondaires ou équivalent. Connaissance de base des systèmes électriques et/ou mécaniques. Être âgé(e) d’au moins 18 ans. Être inscrit(e) ou avoir complété des études d'un établissement d’enseignement technique (collège/centre de formation). Microsoft s'engage à préserver la langue française et à promouvoir son usage dans le cadre professionnel le cas échéant. Cependant, pour ce rôle en particulier, la maîtrise de l’anglais est une exigence professionnelle justifiée en raison des tâches techniques et spécialisées nécessitant l’utilisation de l'anglais afin de répondre aux besoins des clients tout en travaillant de manière intégrée avec des collègues du monde entier. La maîtrise de la communication orale et écrite en français est considérée comme un atout. Exigences en matière de vérification des antécédents : La capacité de satisfaire aux exigences de vérification de sécurité de Microsoft, de ses clients et/ou des autorités gouvernementales est requise pour ce poste. Ces exigences comprennent, sans s’y limiter, les vérifications spécialisées suivantes : Vérification des antécédents Microsoft Cloud : Ce poste exige de réussir la vérification des antécédents Microsoft Cloud au moment de l’embauche ou d’un transfert, ainsi que tous les deux ans par la suite. Le candidat retenu doit actuellement être en mesure d’obtenir une cote de fiabilité délivrée par un ministère ou organisme autorisé du gouvernement du Canada. Ce processus comprend notamment : La vérification de l’identité, des antécédents, de la formation, des titres professionnels, des références personnelles et professionnelles, ainsi qu’une vérification de crédit et des antécédents judiciaires. La cote de fiabilité peut également nécessiter un questionnaire de sécurité et une entrevue de sécurité. Afin d’obtenir l’autorisation requise dans les délais prescrits, les candidats doivent avoir résidé de façon continue au Canada pendant au moins cinq (5) ans et ne pas avoir vécu ou travaillé à l’extérieur du Canada pendant plus de six (6) mois durant cette période, à moins que Microsoft ne juge que l’autorisation peut néanmoins être obtenue dans les délais requis. Qualifications souhaitées : Diplôme en génie électrique ou mécanique. Capacité à effectuer des tâches nécessitant de rester debout, de marcher fréquemment, de soulever des charges et de travailler en hauteur, avec ou sans équipement d’assistance. Capacité à communiquer efficacement avec divers intervenants. Intérêt marqué pour l’apprentissage, le développement et l’acquisition de nouvelles compétences techniques. Flexibilité pour travailler en dehors des heures normales d’affaires, y compris les fins de semaine et/ou les jours fériés. Job Overview: We're hiring for multiple 6-month internship positions beginning in January 2027. In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a Datacenter Critical Environment Technician (CET) Apprentice. Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CET Apprentice, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications. Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 100 datacenters and 1 million servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. Do you want to empower billions across the world? Come and join us in CO+I and be at the forefront of the action! Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. Responsibilities Responsibilities: Learn how to operate all systems and equipment in a safe and professional manner and learn about all risks associated with these systems, with the opportunity to complete your Microsoft CET Level 1. Perform basic monitoring and inspection of critical environment-related facility equipment, building, and grounds for unsafe or abnormal conditions and basic monitoring of the performance of maintenance and operations of equipment (e.g., electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety) within the data center. Utilize internal computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) to track all equipment assets and to complete work order requests for maintenance work. Safely assist in providing emergency monitoring and response to various abnormal conditions with supervision following emergency operating procedures (EOPs). Gather necessary information and participate in the creation of incident timelines/data, root-cause analyses, and/or action items following an abnormal condition as required. Perform various types of maintenance (e.g., planned, predictive, corrective) as assigned following methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Provide assistance by prepping materials and performing administrative tasks as instructed. Document tasks/issues found in maintenance and troubleshooting for follow up as needed and escalate as appropriate. Embody our culture and values . Qualifications Required Qualifications: High School Diploma or equivalent. Basic knowledge of electrical and/or mechanical systems Minimum of 18 years of age. You are studying at/or have graduated from a technical college. Microsoft is committed to upholding the French language's status and ensuring its use in the workplace where applicable. However, for this specific role, proficiency in English is a bona fide occupational requirement due to technical and specialized tasks requiring the use of English to meet customer needs while working in an integrated fashion with colleagues around the world. Proficiency in verbal and written communication in French is considered an asset. Background Check Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter The successful candidate currently has the ability to obtain Reliability Status screening from a duly authorized department or agency of the Government of Canada. This process includes but is not limited to: Verification of identity, background, education, professional credentials, personal and professional references, credit check and criminal background check. Reliability Status screening may also require a security questionnaire and security interview. To obtain the requisite clearance within required timelines, applicants must have five (5) years of continuous Canadian residency and must not have lived or worked outside of Canada for more than six (6) months during that time unless Microsoft is satisfied that the requisite clearance can nevertheless be obtained within required timelines. Preferred Qualifications: Electrical or mechanical engineer diploma. Ability to support frequent standing, walking, lifting, and working at heights with or without equipment assistance. Able to communicate effectively with multiple stakeholders. Desire to learn, grow, and develop new technical skills. Flexibility to work non-standard business hours that may include weekends and/or holidays. Notre infrastructure comprend un vaste portefeuille mondial de plus de 100 datacenters et 1 million de serveurs. Notre fondation repose sur une équipe d’experts qui s’efforce de soutenir des services pour plus d’un milliard de clients et 20 millions d’entreprises dans plus de 90 pays à travers le monde. Avec la durabilité environnementale et l’optimisation au cœur de la conception et des opérations de nos datacenters, nous continuons à croître et à évoluer pour répondre aux besoins commerciaux en constante évolution qui font de Microsoft un fournisseur cloud de classe mondiale. Vous souhaitez donner du pouvoir à des milliards de personnes dans le monde ? Rejoignez-nous chez CO+I et soyez au cœur de l’action ! La mission de Microsoft est de permettre à chaque personne et à chaque organisation sur la planète d’accomplir davantage. En tant qu’employés, nous nous réunissons avec un état d’esprit de croissance, innovons pour autonomiser les autres et collaborons pour réaliser nos objectifs communs. La maîtrise de la communication orale et écrite en français est considérée comme un atout. jobs.title: Software Engineering - PhD Intern
jobs.descriptionText: Job Details: Job Description: The Role and Impact Intel is seeking a highly motivated Software Research Intern (PhD) to join the TCAD Process Reliability Modeling team within Intel Foundry. This internship offers an opportunity to work on advanced computational software solutions supporting semiconductor technology development. The selected candidate will contribute to cutting-edge software applications and solution methodologies like chip-package interactions, thermal transport and thermal management, thin films development and patterning. The internship is designed for PhD students interested in applying software engineering and research expertise to solve complex engineering challenges while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across Intel. Business Group The Intel Foundry Technology organization is focused on driving semiconductor process innovation and enabling future technology nodes. Within the LTD-TD TCAD team, engineers and researchers develop advanced simulation, modeling, and software solutions used to accelerate technology development. The team fosters a collaborative environment where software, mathematics, physics, and engineering intersect to solve challenging technical problems. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and optimize software solutions for engineering and research applications. Develop simulations capabilities using numerical methods like finite element, level sets, or related techniques. Develop modeling-based methodologies to solve device and interconnect process, module and reliability problems. Establish criteria and methods to determine proper inputs and validate results. Collaborate with software engineers, researchers, and domain experts to deliver scalable and maintainable solutions. Document technical solutions and present findings to project stakeholders. Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications Must be a full-time student pursuing a Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering, Material Science, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a semiconductor-related field. Must have a minimum of a 3.0 GPA in college courses to date. 1+ year experience programming in C/C++/Python or equivalent. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and software development skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with using TCAD or atomistic simulation tools to study thermo-mechanical and chip/package interactions, thermal transport, thin film deposition processes, patterning, material chemical interactions or circuit performance. Hands on experience development and/or using finite element or equivalent solvers for solutions of physical systems. Experience with physics-based modeling, AI/machine learning methodologies for the analysis of solid mechanics, thermal management, reliability and manufacturing process of microprocessors devices. This is your opportunity to develop your expertise, gain hands-on experience, and make a meaningful impact within a collaborative environment that drives the future of technology. We look forward to seeing how your skills and passion will contribute to our innovative team. jobs.title: Research Intern - Security Research Group, Microsoft Research Redmond
jobs.descriptionText: Overview Research Internships at Microsoft provide a dynamic environment for research careers with a network of world-class research labs led by globally-recognized scientists and engineers, who pursue innovation in a range of scientific and technical disciplines to help solve complex challenges in diverse fields, including computing, healthcare, economics, and the environment. The Security Research Group at Microsoft Research Redmond works on a variety of areas to ensure computer systems are secure and trustworthy. Its current work investigates systems that leverage general software/systems security, confidential computing, formal verification, zero-knowledge proofs, data-driven security, and agentic security. The internship will explore new ideas and approaches to building secure and trustworthy software and cloud services. Responsibilities Research Interns put inquiry and theory into practice. Alongside fellow doctoral candidates and some of the world’s best researchers, Research Interns learn, collaborate, and network for life. Research Interns not only advance their own careers, but they also contribute to exciting research and development strides. During the 12-week internship, Research Interns are paired with mentors and expected to collaborate with other Research Interns and researchers, present findings, and contribute to the vibrant life of the community. Research internships are available in all areas of research, and are offered year-round, though they typically begin in the summer. Qualifications Required Qualifications Currently enrolled in a Doctorate Degree program in Computer Science, STEM, or a related field. Other Requirements Research Interns are expected to be physically located in their manager’s Microsoft worksite location for the duration of their internship. In addition to the qualifications below, you’ll need to submit a minimum of two reference letters for this position as well as a cover letter and any relevant work or research samples. After you submit your application, a request for letters may be sent to your list of references on your behalf. Note that reference letters cannot be requested until after you have submitted your application, and furthermore, that they might not be automatically requested for all candidates. You may wish to alert your letter writers in advance, so they will be ready to submit your letter. Preferred Qualifications Ability to build and extend complex software (e.g., operating systems, distributed systems, proof systems). Demonstrated ability to develop and execute an original research agenda. The base pay range for this internship is USD $6,810 - $13,480 per month. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $8,920 - $14,610 per month. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. You will be at the centre of a chip design effort working with all disciplines, with a critical impact on getting high performant products to millions of Apple customers efficiently. Locations: These roles will be based in London, St Albans or Cambridge. You will have the opportunity to express your location preferences if selected for interview. We will be hiring for the below internships in 2026/27 and across the available start dates: Autumn / Winter 2026 or Spring / Summer 2027. Architecture Validation: Building experience interpreting hardware functional specifications together with architects, micro-architects, and designers, you will be able to build bit-accurate C/C++ models of the GPU or design workloads to verify new GPU features through models. You will partner with our verification and software teams to identify bugs in the workloads, model and hardware, collaborate to verify architectural solutions, and communicate recommendations to the wider team. Performance Modelling: You will have impact in defining and optimising Apple's GPU micro-architecture. Through collaboration, you will seek out areas for GPU performance improvement while collecting data and measurements that either confirm new features or rule them out. You will work with experienced designers in micro-architecture and RTL to assess the feasibility of ideas, refine them and create new ones. The role requires the analysis of interesting workloads across existing and new product categories to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement. You will be architecting new simulator features and brainstorming novel ideas to boost simulation performance. We also cross-collaborate as a larger performance team to maintain and improve the simulation environment and look for ways to boost the productivity of the entire team. Platform Architecture: Are you ready to be at the forefront of architecting the next generation of Apple GPUs? This role will require you to analyze the performance of existing and future looking workloads and propose, alongside with world-class GPU and SoC Architects, new features and research on novel ideas to boost to new heights the performance of our GPUs. To do so, you’ll use performance and energy models to evaluate, iterate and tune the different ideas until the proposal is mature enough to be presented to senior GPU Architects to make a decision on its feasibility. You’ll also cross-collaborate as a larger architecture and performance team to maintain and improve the simulation environment and look for ways to boost the productivity of the entire team.

jobs.title: Research Intern
jobs.descriptionText: Overview Come build community, explore your passions and do your best work at Microsoft with thousands of University interns from every corner of the world. This opportunity will allow you to bring your aspirations, talent, potential - and excitement for the journey ahead. Microsoft Research Asia (MSRA) is now poised to extend roles into Singapore and looking for talents in Foundation Model innovations (LLM, vision, multi-modality, etc.), Deep Learning and Reinforcement Learning Foundation, Industrial AI application (e.g., AI for Healthcare, Embodied AI and Robotics, etc.). As a Research Intern, you will conduct research and leads research collaborations that yield new insights, theories, analyses, data, algorithms, and/or prototypes that advance the state-of-the-art of computer science and engineering, as well as general scientific knowledge. You will formulate research problems in an area of study and initiates the design, development, execution and implementation of a research agenda to further academic knowledge and close identified gaps and provide expertise to product or business groups and may create long-term business opportunities through research outcomes, but not responsible for addressing immediate product needs or demonstrating a clear path to product. We are seeking candidates excelling in deep thinking research aspects and fast-paced entrepreneurial execution. The ideal candidates should have the ability to work with researchers and product team colleagues at Microsoft to push forward research agendas, being a team player in a collaborative and supportive environment with outstanding programming skills. We are seeking candidates with research skills and technical backgrounds. Applicants should demonstrate depth of knowledge in Natural Language Understanding, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Algorithmic Foundations of Optimization, Data Mining or Machine Intelligence (Artificial Intelligence) as well as strong academia experience in data processing, experimentation, and modeling. Microsoft works with the world's best researchers, moving with the current of technology as it rapidly evolves. Together we share the motivation to seek innovative solutions to the world's toughest challenges and improve the lives of people everywhere. Microsoft provides a nurturing environment to support passionate researchers and engineers in AI technology innovation. Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. Responsibilities Analyze and improve performance of advanced algorithms on large-scale datasets and cutting-edge research in machine intelligence and machine learning applications. Implement prototypes of scalable systems in AI applications. Collaborate closely with team members on developing systems from prototyping to production level. Develop solutions for real world, large-scale problems. Under instruction from others, research new tools, technologies, and methods being used in the research community and contribute your knowledge around a specialized tool/method to support planning for research projects. Gain an understanding of their research as it relates to Microsoft products or business groups and assists in technology transfer attempts, participating on standards organizations, filing patents, authoring white papers, developing or maintaining tools/services for internal Microsoft use, or consulting for product or business groups. Qualifications Required Qualifications: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or related disciplines). Must have at least one additional quarter/semester of school remaining following the completion of the internship. Preferred Qualifications: Proficiency in one or more general-purpose programming languages, particularly Python. Familiarity with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar toolkits. Hands-on experience with training and/or inference of large-scale models, including Large Language Models (LLMs) and/or Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and/or diffusion models. Demonstrated academic experience, including publications in top-tier conferences or journals, in one or more of the following areas: Natural Language Understanding Computer Vision Machine Learning and Deep Learning Reinforcement Learning Large Language Model or Generative AI This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.

jobs.descriptionText: The Applied Data Solutions Program (ADSP) Internship is your opportunity to bring your technical education background to life by solving real-world problems and developing data-driven solutions. Immersed in a culture of collaboration and innovation, you'll work directly with Apple's extensive data infrastructure and analytics platforms, tackling challenges designed to engage your curiosity and expand your skillset. You'll have close mentorship to support your growth in both technical expertise and professional skills, and your work will have a direct and measurable impact. If you're a student who is curious, passionate about data and analytics, and loves solving complex problems, we'd love to hear from you. To express interest in the Applied Data Solutions Program (ADSP) Summer 2027 Internship, please provide both your: • Resume • Unofficial transcript The ADSP Internship spans multiple teams, with opportunities across machine learning engineering, software engineering, data science, and AI development. While the team you're placed on will be determined by your background and technical focus, you can expect to: • Work side-by-side with Software Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, and Data Scientists to design, build, and deploy scalable, production-grade systems and tools. • Apply data analysis, predictive modeling, and generative AI techniques to build and maintain end-to-end operational solutions. • Work with large, complex data sets to drive solutions through analytical models and translate data into impactful, actionable insights. • Collaborate with technical partners to implement robust real-time and batch decisioning pipelines in production environments. • Explore and contribute to emerging AI/ML capabilities, including large language model (LLM) integration and applied machine intelligence.

jobs.title: Computer Vision Scientist Intern, Geometry and 3D Vision
GPU Design Verification Internship
jobs.locationText: Cambridge, United Kingdom ; London, United Kingdom ; Saint Albans, United Kingdom
jobs.descriptionText: Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Multifaceted, amazing people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here. The people who work here have reinvented entire industries with all Apple Hardware products. The same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices strengthening our commitment to leave the world better than we found it. Join us to help deliver the next groundbreaking Apple product! Do you love working on challenges that no one has solved yet? As a member of our dynamic group, you will have the unique and rewarding opportunity to craft upcoming products that will delight and inspire millions of Apple’s customers every single day. The UK GPU team works on IPs that are part of Apple’s world-class GPU designs for Apple Silicon SoCs. We are seeking highly motivated, innovative and confident individuals to join us. You will be at the centre of a chip design effort working with all disciplines, with a critical impact on getting high performant products to millions of Apple customers efficiently. Locations: Internships in the GPU Team can be based in London Bishopsgate, St Albans or Cambridge. You may express your location preferences if selected for interview. Start dates: Winter 2026 or Spring / Summer 2027. Key Dates: Applications will close by mid-October. Initial interviews will take place in mid/late October, with final round interviews in November. We will be hiring for the below internship across the available start dates: Winter 2026 or Spring / Summer 2027. Design Verification: You'll be part of creating comprehensive verification plans and contributing to test bench development, from stimulating real-world scenarios to ensuring designs are robust and complete. Collaborating closely with our expert architects and designers, you'll play a crucial role in identifying and addressing issues early in the design cycle. With hands-on mentorship, you'll not only implement key components of our verification flows but also sharpen your debugging skills as you tackle complex testbench and design challenges. This is a great opportunity to build expertise and make a real impact while working alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry.

RTL Design: You will assist with delivering high quality IP in order to meet performance, feature, timing, area and power goals.
